I have a complete picture. Here are my findings.

## Summary

This is the Spring PetClinic REST codebase. All the logic you asked about hangs off the single endpoint `POST /api/owners` (an OfficeFloor function pipeline) plus a MapStruct mapper that derives read-only fields on GET. Note: `fiscalYear` does **not** exist yet in production code — it appears only as an expectation in a (target) acceptance test.

### 1. Membership identifier and how the year segment is derived

The membership *number* is derived in the mapper, not stored on the entity.

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
- `membershipNumber(Owner)` (lines 71-76) — format `"<customerCode>-M<YY>"` where YY is the year segment:
```java
return String.format("%s-M%02d", owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100);
```
So the **year segment is `registrationDate.getYear() % 100`** (last two digits of the registration-date year, e.g. `M26`). Returns null if `customerCode` or `registrationDate` is absent.
- `checkDigit(Owner)` (lines 80-82) — `Luhn.checkDigit(owner.getCustomerCode())`.
- Wired via `@Mapping` at lines 32-33.

The `customerCode` (the `<REGION>-<HASH8>` base of the membership number) is built by:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CustomerCode.java` — `of(region, normalizedTelephone, lastName)` (line 27), `deduplicate(...)` (line 36), `region(...)` (line 49). No year is involved here; HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java` — `service(...)` (lines 28-36) assigns/dedups the code before persist.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Luhn.java` — `checkDigit(String)` (line 17).

### 2. Tenure calculation (365-day window / years since registration)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerMembershipPoints.java`
- Constant `TENURE_DAYS_FOR_BONUS = 365` (line 39); `LONG_TENURE_POINTS = 3` (line 36).
- `tenureDays(LocalDate registrationDate)` (lines 71-73):
```java
return ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(registrationDate, LocalDate.now());
```
- Applied in `service(...)` line 52: `if (tenureDays(registrationDate) > TENURE_DAYS_FOR_BONUS) points += LONG_TENURE_POINTS;`. A newly-registered owner has zero tenure, so never earns it.

A related "years since a date" derivation (completed years, not tenure) is in:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/AgeBand.java` — `of(birthDate, referenceDate)` (line 25) uses `Period.between(...).getYears()`.

Downstream of points: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerMembershipLevel.java` — `levelFor(int points)` (lines 19-30) maps points to level 1-4.

### 3. Business-day adjustment of the registration date

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/BusinessDay.java`
- `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set (lines 15-20): five pinned 2026 dates (Jan 1, Jan 26, Apr 25, Dec 25, Dec 28).
- `rollForward(LocalDate)` (lines 30-36) advances past Saturdays, Sundays, and those holidays; `isBusinessDay(...)` (line 38).

Registration-date pipeline (order: validate → resolve → apply):
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate.java` — `service(...)` (line 20) rejects a future supplied date with `InvalidOwnerFieldsException("registrationDate")` (400).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ResolveOwnerRegistrationDate.java` — `service(...)` (line 19): `registrationDate.set(BusinessDay.rollForward(supplied != null ? supplied : LocalDate.now()))`. This resolved value is what tenure/capacity/membership-number all use.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ApplyOwnerRegistrationDate.java` — `service(...)` (line 17) stamps it onto the `Owner` (`owner.setRegistrationDate(...)`). Its javadoc explicitly notes "the membership number's year segment uses the adjusted business day."

Field on the entity: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `registrationDate` field (line 67), getter/setter (lines 169-174).

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, normalized like
            'address'. When present it is appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this becomes the
            composed, normalized address ('addressLine1' plus a space and 'addressLine2' when
            present). Stored and returned in normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner, stored in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 9
          maxLength: 16
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            owner's city, i.e. within the inclusive range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-18'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            is stored and returned, and the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares this owner a member of an existing household and bypasses the
            duplicate block, permitting creation even though another owner shares the same
            lastName and postcode. Such a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the courtesy 'title' followed by a space and the
                lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for people to read: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits in space-separated groups of three.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION segment of the owner's customerCode: the canonical region the code was
                built from (derived from the postcode range first, falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred way to reach the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only
                when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName). Deterministic from the
                owner's region and identity, with no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName +
                '|' + postcode). Assigned to every owner, so any two owners with the same lastName
                and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating telephone, email
                and household: 'normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId-or-empty'. Two
                owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Membership number derived as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership score assigned at creation, starting at 0: +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 when
                tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level assigned at creation, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, another owner already shared this owner's lastName
                and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match), otherwise false. An
                owner created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never
                flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on lastName and postcode
                at creation. Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE marks it true while retaining the record, so the owner is still returned
                by GET. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

**New unit — `util/FiscalYear.java`** (single responsibility: fiscal-year math on a `LocalDate`):
- `of(date)` — the fiscal year (its ending calendar year); the date's own year before 1 July, next year on/after.
- `label(date)` — `'FY<YY>'`.
- `elapsed(from, to)` — whole fiscal years crossed between two dates.

- `label(date)` — `'FY<YY>'`.
- `elapsed(from, to)` — whole fiscal years crossed between two dates.

**`OwnerMapper`** — reuses `FiscalYear`:
- `membershipNumber` year segment now uses `FiscalYear.of(registrationDate) % 100` instead of the calendar year (`M27` for today's Sept-2026 date, previously `M26`).
- Added a `fiscalYear(owner)` deriver + `@Mapping`, returning `FiscalYear.label(registrationDate)` (null when the date is absent).

**`AssignOwnerMembershipPoints`** — tenure now counts **elapsed fiscal years** via `FiscalYear.elapsed(...)` (`> 1` fiscal year) rather than a 365-day window; dropped the now-unused `ChronoUnit` import and renamed the constant/helper accordingly. A newly-registered owner still has zero tenure, so never earns the bonus.

**`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `fiscalYear` (`FY<YY>`) field to `OwnerDto` (so the generated DTO gets the setter MapStruct needs) and updated the `membershipNumber`/`membershipPoints` descriptions. Touched the `ApplyOwnerRegistrationDate` javadoc for accuracy.

The new acceptance test `coreReturnsFiscalYear` passes (`fiscalYear` matches `FY\d{2}`), and the existing `BusinessDayTest` (6) remains green — 7/7 overall.

Note on the naming convention: `FY<YY>` is named by the year the fiscal year *ends* (dominant AU business convention, matching the app's AU theming). The acceptance test only checks the `FY\d{2}` format, so it doesn't pin the convention — flag this if your spec intends naming by the *start* year instead, which is a one-line change in `FiscalYear.of`.
